precore_boundary: Freeze baseline before opening any project candidate, profile, research or other arm. Wait for coordinator installation signal before retrieval.

technical_gates.request: Exact current request and active span/topic context hash bound.
technical_gates.controls: Saved controls frozen; sensual=1, fetish=0, surreal=0, creativity=1.
technical_gates.reference: Direct inspection and actual generator reference argument recorded.
technical_gates.retrieval: Installed refreshed release receipt proves exposure; returned source meaning reviewed completely and separately from pixels.
technical_gates.render: Managed compose-audit and native prepare-render pass; exactly one built-in image call; actual image saved in workspace with hash and ledger.

pixel_gates.pass: Recognizable lavish private table plus at least two visible decay/excess cues, such as spoiled dessert/fruit, slumped floral display or tarnished service.
pixel_gates.fail: Only clean wealth or generic clutter.

pixel_gates.pass: Intimate home dining/service relation remains readable, and visible stopped service plus apprehensive attention or contradictory household traces creates threat disrupting ritual.
pixel_gates.fail: Ordinary meal service or disconnected glamorous portrait.

pixel_gates.pass: Bloodlike crimson sprayed droplets or fan-shaped spatter are visibly distributed across at least two domestic surfaces, integrated into the unsettling event rather than a benign pouring scene.
pixel_gates.fail: Only red decor, a clean pool, or an equally benign food/wine spill without horror implication.
pixel_gates.qualification: This tests a non-graphic residue realization; even PASS does not establish explicit gore or every possible Splatter Horror convention.

pixel_gates.pass: At least three of face/gaze, stopped trolley, marked wheel, linked table and service doorway are visible together with an understandable relation.
pixel_gates.fail: Objects are unrelated or the movement and cause cannot be read.

pixel_gates.pass: Visible dark bob/fine fringe and facial proportions remain recognizably guided by supplied portrait at scene scale.
pixel_gates.fail: Unrelated appearance or face too occluded to assess.
pixel_gates.qualification: No identity or age inference; resemblance is an image-grounded judgment.

pixel_gates.pass: Visible ownership, reachable handle grip, support and trolley/floor relation are spatially plausible.

observability_rule: Every gate is visible, partial or unobservable. Only fully visible sufficient evidence may PASS. Partial/unobservable is never promoted to full PASS. Contract/audit PASS is not pixel PASS. User preference and acceptance remain pending.
overall_rule: Report technical integrity, source exposure, observed composite theme expression and user acceptance separately; do not call the combined pixel result PASS if any required experimental theme gate is partial or unobservable.
